title: dionysia cespitosa subsp. bolivarii

It is a rare and endangered succulent plant native to Iran and Afghanistan, characterized by its compact growth habit and small, white flowers. Studies have shown that Bolivarian Dionysia has potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
